title: Active Users
summary: Find accounts that have logins on at least five consecutive calendar days. Several logins on one day count as one.
inputFormat: SQL. Accounts(id, name) with primary key id. Logins(id, login_date) with login_date a date; duplicate (id, login_date) rows are possible.
outputFormat: SQL result: id and name for each qualifying account, sorted by id ascending.
edgeRules: Logins on the same day are counted once. A run of at least five consecutive days is required.

examples.input: user 7 logs in on 1-5 and 1-5 again; user 8 logs in on 1-2,1-3,1-4,1-5
